title: Business & Accounting Analyst
description:
An established construction company is seeking a qualified Business & Accounting Analyst for their team located in Gallipolis, Ohio. This role is central to ensuring financial accuracy, compliance, and strategic insight across our construction projects.

🛠️ Key Responsibilities

Project Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Monitor project budgets, costs, and revenue recognition
  • Track expenses including labor, materials, and overhead
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
  • Analyze financial data to identify trends and variances
  • Collaborate with project managers to optimize profitability

Cost Analysis & Budgeting

  • Conduct detailed cost analysis and identify savings opportunities
  • Prepare budget forecasts and cost-to-complete reports
  • Implement cost control measures and ensure budget adherence

Payroll & Compliance

  • Oversee payroll processing and ensure compliance with regulations
  • Manage certified payroll and prevailing wage documentation
  • Coordinate union fringe benefits and annual true-ups
  • Support state registrations and third-party tax compliance

Audit & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate financial records and documentation
  • Assist with internal and external audits, insurance reviews, and workers' comp true-ups
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, company policies, and agency requirements (ODOT, DOE, etc.)

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with project managers, engineers, contractors, and vendors
  • Communicate financial information clearly to non-financial audiences
  • Participate in project meetings and support financial decision-making

This is a direct hire, full-time role, hiring immediately. The schedule is weekdays and business hours. Starting hourly rate is $30 per hour and this company offers health, dental, vision, life, and short-term disability insurance. There is not currently a 401(k) plan.

🎯 Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA a plus)
  • 2+ years of experience in construction accounting or public accounting
  • Strong understanding of US GAAP and construction project financials
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas) and accounting software (Foundation, Sage, or similar)
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
  • High ethical standards and professional integrity
  • Demonstrated initiative and adaptability in changing environments

title: Office Assistant
description:
Summary:
Office assistant needed for a busy service provider located in Athens County, Ohio. Will be supporting the team by doing essential office functions.
  • Updating customer information in a database/work order system.
  • Scheduling appointments/updating service contracts.
  • Preparing work orders and correspondence.
  • Answering phones and taking messages.
  • Filing and scanning.
  • Other administrative duties as needed.
This is a temp-to-direct, full-time position. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pay is commensurate with experience, starting at $15 per hour.

Qualifications:
  • Prior customer service experience is required.
  • Dependable, excellent communicator, and works well in a team environment.
  • Computer fluency, especially with MS Office.
  • Highly organized and excellent attention to detail.

title: Office Assistant
